summary: RCR Partners is a Norwood, Adelaide accounting and advisory firm led by Alessio Roscio since 2011, with tiered Xero-based packages (Compliance, Advisory, Virtual CFO) and an optional bookkeeping add-on. The site says it is rebranding. Alessio also co-founded Curated Capital.

claims.text: RCR Partners is based at Level 1, 125b The Parade, Norwood, South Australia.
claims.quote: Level 1, 125b The Parade, Norwood, SA 5067, Australia

claims.text: Alessio Roscio is Owner & Managing Director of RCR Partners (current on LinkedIn, since October 2011).
claims.quote: Owner & Managing Director, RCR Partners | Co-founder & Director, Curated Capital

claims.text: Alessio is also co-founder and director of Curated Capital, a commercial property investment company.
claims.quote: Co-Founder and Director of Curated Capital, a property investment company focusing on office, retail and industrial commercial properties

claims.text: The firm says Alessio is actively involved in many industries, including at board and ownership level outside the firm.
claims.quote: Alessio is actively involved in many industries including at a board and ownership level outside the firm.

claims.text: The Virtual CFO package includes monthly management reports, monthly review meetings and KPI development.
An optional bookkeeping add-on covers bank reconciliation, payroll, AR/AP and a monthly review of data.
A Xero subscription is included in every package.
LinkedIn lists 13 employees across Australia and the Philippines.
claims.quote: RCR Partners employs 13 people (-5.9% YoY, -1 person).

claims.text: The website says RCR Partners is rebranding and launching a new website.
claims.quote: We’re working on a new look and a new website.

claims.text: Services include monthly and quarterly board reporting and cloud accounting.

hooks.text: Monthly management reports in the Virtual CFO tier depend on timely reconciliation.
Owner with outside commitments (Curated Capital, boards): time-poor, values leverage.
Rebrand underway: a natural moment to revisit workflows.

risks.text: Team of 13 across Australia and the Philippines suggests offshore bookkeeping already in place; Vert must complement it.
Website is partly outdated (mid-rebrand); some service pages may not reflect current offering.

gaps: No recent dated posts by Alessio found.
No podcast or press coverage found.
